question: For 2025, list the top three order-recorded cities by Delivered-order GMV in INR. For each city, also show Delivered order count and AOV. Treat each exact city label as one city.

action.query: SELECT CITY, COUNT(*) AS DELIVERED_ORDER_COUNT, SUM(DELIVERED_SALES_AMOUNT) AS DELIVERED_GMV_INR, SUM(DELIVERED_SALES_AMOUNT) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS AOV_INR FROM ZOMATO_DLR.CORE.FACT_ORDER WHERE ORDER_DATE >= '2025-01-01' AND ORDER_DATE < '2026-01-01' AND CURRENCY = 'INR' AND IS_DELIVERED = TRUE GROUP BY CITY ORDER BY DELIVERED_GMV_INR DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 3
action.metrics: Delivered-order GMV = sum of delivered sales amount; delivered order count; AOV = GMV / delivered order count. INR source currency only.

action.answer: For orders with recorded ORDER_DATE in 2025, the top three exact city labels by Delivered-order GMV in INR are: 1) Bangalore — delivered GMV ₹233,341,258.00; 440,743 delivered orders; AOV ₹529.427031 per delivered order. 2) Delhi — delivered GMV ₹177,702,873.00; 339,384 delivered orders; AOV ₹523.604156 per delivered order. 3) Chennai — delivered GMV ₹155,055,243.00; 310,963 delivered orders; AOV ₹498.629236 per delivered order. AOV is delivered GMV divided by delivered order count. Amounts use the INR source-currency records; cities are grouped by exact label.
